title: Every command setup tells the caregiver to run does not exist
method: static-read of install.sh and the repo's packaging + shell probe of the installed venv
observed_at_discovery: `cura rehearse` -> 'bash: cura: command not found', exit 127, with .venv/bin first on PATH. `.venv/bin/python -m cura rehearse` from /tmp -> 'No module named cura'. No pyproject.toml, no setup.py, no console_scripts, no cura script in .venv/bin. The wizard's closing screen and add_phone's closing screen both end on these commands; `cura run` is the one that starts the daily calls, so the phone never rings and setup reported success.
